headline: Crude Oil Prices Drop as Stock Market Selloff Weighs on Commodities
summary: Brent crude fell to $92.55 per barrel and WTI declined to $83.45 per barrel as doubts about artificial intelligence growth triggered a stock selloff, despite continuing tanker attacks in the Persian Gulf.
why: Crude oil is the world's major energy commodity and a key macro economic indicator.

impacts.name: Brent crude
impacts.why: Brent crude prices declined amid a global stock market selloff driven by artificial intelligence valuation concerns.
